title: The Greatest Miracle
verse: When Jesus perceived their thoughts he said, “Why do you respond with evil in your hearts? Which is easier, to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven’ or to say, ‘Stand up and walk’? But so that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins”—then he said to the paralytic—“Stand up, take your stretcher, and go home.
observation: Jesus shows infinite kindness to the paralyzed man, giving him the greatest miracle first. Those around did not see Jesus as God, so they thought it was impossible for Jesus to absolve this man of his sin. Jesus shows us all that forgiving sin and healing a sickness is impossible for us, but both are possible for Him. We can have confidence that, even if we cannot see it the way we might see a physical healing, our sins can be forgiven. Jesus gave this man the greatest gift first. He was free from his sin. Then, He healed his body as well. Never forget that your salvation is just as much a miracle as watching someone paralyzed getting up and walking. It is the greatest miracle.
application: Think of yourself as someone who has received a healing that would shock the world around you. It’s true. You have received salvation.
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us the greatest miracle we could receive when You gave us Your salvation.
